# inkog

inkog is private, anonymous chat for temporary conversations. Create a time-bound room, share its link, talk without profiles, and use quick polls when a group needs a decision.

## What inkog is

inkog is a web app for short-lived group conversations. It is designed for people who want to create a private room, invite participants with a link, and chat under anonymous aliases instead of account profiles.

## How inkog works

1. Create a room with a name, duration, participant limit, and optional password.
2. Share the room link with the people who should join.
3. Chat or create a poll while the room is active.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://inkog.chat/): Start or join a temporary room.
- [About inkog](https://inkog.chat/about): Product facts, privacy boundaries, and frequently asked questions.

## Boundaries
- Room URLs are private, temporary conversation spaces and are not part of this public knowledge index.
- Do not infer guarantees about encryption, deletion, or data retention beyond the public pages.
